what: back.txt (check27) holds only installed-checker false positives, but they make the checker skip crates: (1) crates/blaze-link/src/cow.rs:208 "lifetime may not live long enough": `unique(shared: &mut Shared<static,[E;N]>) -> &mut [E;N]` returns `Shared::get_mut(shared)`, whose signature (blaze-mem pool.rs:611 `get_mut(this: &mut Self) -> Option<&mut T>`) ties the result to that borrow; valid Rust, a borrowck bug in blaze 0.20261028.7. Because blaze-link counts as failed, blaze-premap, blaze-cargo and blaze-engine have not been checked since. (2) fuzz/src/raw.rs x11 unresolved macro `sanitize`: hir-expand lacked the built-in; fixed in the tree by 00909 but not in the installed checker; blaze-fuzzer and its 50+ target bins go unchecked. Decide: run the check with a blaze built from the tree (has 00909), and/or have front-ty borrowck fix (1), or accept that these crates are verified only at blaze build. fix-back leaves both files as they are (valid code).

history.note: coordinator -> fix-borrowck-cow: cow.rs:208 is a v2 borrow checker false positive; new lane fix-borrowck-cow owns the fix. fuzz/src/raw.rs sanitize already fixed in v2 by fix-fuzz.
